# Frontend Design — Portable Fallback

Use for product interface design, high-fidelity reference replication and design-system direction.

## Load progressively

- `references/design-system-audit.md` — extract and reuse the existing/template system.
- `references/states-responsive.md` — complete interaction/responsive state coverage.
- `references/reference-replication.md` — learn from screenshots/live templates without superficial imitation.

## Workflow

1. Understand user task and information hierarchy.
2. Inspect actual product/template/design references.
3. Inventory components and required states.
4. Extract tokens/layout/component grammar.
5. Reuse strong patterns before inventing new primitives.
6. Produce representative screens.
7. Inspect rendered output across target viewports/states.
8. Iterate on systematic problems first, page-local polish second.
9. Handoff implementation-ready component/state guidance.

Do not reduce a reference design to “similar colors and cards”.
